findings.issue: Qal sequential perfect 2mp is the addressees counting, with לכם to or for those same addressees. “contarán a ustedes” makes another party the counter and the addressees the ones told or counted.
Common nouns שַׁבָּת and שַׁבָּתוֹת are left untranslated as shabat and shabats.
Common noun עֹמֶר is left untranslated as ómer.
מָחֳרָת is the following day; mañana is readily read as morning.
balanceo is an uncertain match for the noun תְּנוּפָה.

notes: Y, desde…desde, día, hiphil su traer, siete, íntegros, and serán match; את adds no separate Spanish word.
